messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Pager storm detected across inference-serving; multiple P1s firing in EU region. Primary for EU night (ash) marked unavailable for the shift. Auto-escalation will kick in at +5m if no primary assigned. See runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/pager-storm :rotating_light:
ash: I'm out for family emergency, sorry. I can shadow for 30m remotely but can't be primary. Need someone to take full handoff for the next 8h.
sam: I can take primary for the next 4h and then pass off to someone in EU morning. Can cover paging and customer comms.
jules: Thanks Sam — can you confirm you can do the usual canary fallback for heavy tail traffic? Last time we needed to scale dedicated pools.
sam: Yes. I'll scale the EU-gpu-pool and enable fallback routing to cpu-surge model variant if needed. Commands I'll run are:
```
# scale up dedicated pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment eu-gpu-pool --replicas=6
# enable fallback routing (feature-flag toggle)
redwoodctl routing set-policy eu fallback:cpu-variant --ttl 15m
```
maria: @sam if you take primary, i'll be secondary for shadowing and can handle customer updates if the incident gets noisy. I'm remote but reachable.
ash: @sam please also add a short blameless note to the incident channel so SREs don't spin up duplicate actions.
kevin: Heads up: metrics show KV cache saturation on model-worker-3; suggests long context sessions. If we scale workers we should increase `--max-concurrent-requests` to keep latency stable.
sam: Good catch. I'll patch worker args. Running: `kubectl set env deployment/model-worker -n inference MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=48` after scaling.
ops-bot: NOTE: Runbook step 4b recommends prefix caching flush if clients see repeated token regressions. Command: `redwoodctl cache flush --prefix=kv://eu/*`
jules: Also ping pure-hosting team to unlock an extra ephemeral GPU if scaling hits quota: https://redwood.example/infra/ephemeral-gpu-request (we have a 10m window for approvals)
maria: I can open the infra request now. Taking care of approvals so @sam can scale right away.
sam: Taking primary now. I'll post a short takeover: "sam is primary EU (2024-10-12 23:15UTC - est 4h)" and update the oncall rota.
ash: Leaving a quick checklist for takeover so incident history is consistent:
- who is primary/secondary
- models affected and model versions
- mitigation steps taken
- any customer-impact notes to send to support
- expected handoff time and next owner

sam: Copy. Primary: sam; Secondary: maria; Shadow: ash (30m); Handoff ETA: 4h then hand to EU-morn team. Models: gptx-13b-v2 serving in EU, fallback cpu-variant enabled. Mitigations: scaled eu-gpu-pool -> 6, patched MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS, KV cache flush queued.
jules: customer-impact: Low for bulk embedding jobs (delayed), Medium for interactive chat sessions (increased latencies, some 504s). Recommend support message template: "We're seeing elevated latency in EU affecting chat features; engineering is mitigating and we'll provide updates every 30 minutes."
maria: I'll coordinate with support and post the first customer update in 10m. @sam please confirm when the fallback routing is live.
sam: Fallback routing set and KV cache flush initiated. Patch applied to workers. Watching metrics (CPU/99th/queue depth).
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged. Auto-escalation timer cleared. Primary assigned: sam. Secondary assigned: maria.
kevin: Metrics look better; 99th latency down ~30% after scaling. Still seeing sporadic 504s tied to model-worker-3, might need a restart if errors persist.
sam: Will restart model-worker-3 gracefully if 504s don't clear in next 12m: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-worker -n inference --field-selector=metadata.name=model-worker-3`
jules: quick note for handover later: document the exact steps you ran in the incident doc and include the small script we used to toggle routing. That helps Optimize team reproduce for cost analysis.
sam: Will add commands and timeline to the incident doc. Thanks everyone.
maria: Shadowing continued. If anyone else can take the post-4h handoff (EU morning), reply here with availability. Prefer EU-based to avoid repeat timezone handoffs.
kevin: I can be available for the 4h handoff and help with infra quota if needed (EU morning).
sam: Great — I'll ping @kevin before the handoff and leave a final state message.
oncall-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents and scheduled 30m follow-ups. Reminder: please set the incident severity and brief for the postmortem.
